correctness.rationale: Every binary qubit POVM gives a Hermitian contraction O=aI+b·sigma with |a|+||b||<=1. Because only two measurement Bloch vectors occur, mixed-state correlations can be preserved by pure representatives. The arcsine response has geodesic Lipschitz constant at most one, and the resulting three-point spherical inequality bounds the signed witness by 3pi/2; sign reversal bounds its negative. An explicit projective configuration attains equality. Endpoint cases follow by continuity.

value.rationale: The result closes an explicit published analytic gap for a canonical early prepare-and-measure qubit witness. It proves the sharp boundary for the full model allowed by the source, including mixed preparations and biased binary POVMs, and supplies a reusable one-Lipschitz Bloch-sphere lemma rather than a finite numerical improvement.
